title: ExplorerPlatforms
responsibility: Lists revision-bound deployment targets with search, status filters and configuration links.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.index
inputs.description: Project and branch history supplied by the Explorer host.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.head
inputs.description: Selected immutable revision; its platforms field supplies every displayed deployment declaration.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.parent
inputs.description: Optional comparison revision accepted by the shared screen interface; it never supplies missing platform settings.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.scope
inputs.description: Selected branch, commit and availability context used by the shared frame.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.route
inputs.description: Current Platforms list or target detail address, including the selected branch and commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.entities
inputs.description: Source-unit context accepted by the shared Explorer screen interface.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.lens
inputs.description: Revision-bound entity information accepted by the shared screen interface.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.client
inputs.description: Host revision loader accepted by the shared Explorer screen interface.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.mediaBase
inputs.description: Host media prefix accepted by the common screen interface.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.onroute
inputs.description: Client navigation callback used by links while preserving branch and commit context.

inputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms.exportHref
inputs.description: Host export URL, or an empty string when no export is served.

outputs.name: ExplorerPlatforms
outputs.description: The four-target catalog or selected platform details, with search, a status dialog and explicit missing-data states.
